_comment: -Q is NOT optional. Without it a Celery worker consumes only
task_default_queue ('background'), so everything task_routes sends to
'publish' or 'media' is queued and never executed.
That is what stopped publishing. Beat logged 'Sending due task
dispatch-due-posts' every 30 seconds and the task was never once received,
because dispatch_due_posts is routed to 'publish'. Meanwhile plan_autopilot
is unrouted, so it landed on 'background', ran fine, and made the worker
look healthy. Image and video generation were dead for the same reason.
If the queues are ever split across services, each worker names its own
subset here and BETWEEN THEM they must cover all three. /health reports a
